author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a set of laws introduced in the last few days and making serious progress. These laws target the operating system and go so deep that they don't trust you with simply providing your date, they want your ID. How do we fight back? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The Worst Age Verification Law Just Dropped...
